[size=5][center]Farm Map: “Forest Haven”[/center][/size][size=3]
[/size][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#d9ead3][size=4][center]Map Overview[/center][/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/color][/font][size=3]Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of harmony with nature on this peaceful farm. The map is designed for players who value beautiful landscapes and thoughtful space organization without unnecessary hassle.

[color=#b4a7d6]Key Location Features[/color]
✓ Separate map: The map does not replace standard farms. Select it from the available list when creating a new game. (Nar I)
✓ Prepared zones: A large dedicated meadow with blue grass for your livestock, an area with forest stumps for regular wood harvesting, and vast grassy fields suitable for plowing and large-scale crop planting.
✓ Dynamic world: Forest resources (mushrooms, ferns, etc.) will naturally spawn in designated areas.
✓ Visual design: A continuous green carpet, scenic waterfalls, a clean river, and a dynamic sky that changes from day to evening.
✓ Convenient layout: The Greenhouse and the Statue of Perfection are placed in beautiful, easily accessible spots close to the house. The house itself is located near the exit to minimize travel time.

[color=#d9d2e9]Warp System (Fast Travel)[/color]

So you spend less time running and more time enjoying farming:
✓ To the Bus Stop (town)
✓ To the backwoods (near the railroad tracks)
✓ Two warps to the Forest (near Marnie’s Ranch)
✓ One-way warp to the Secret Woods (you were warned)[/size]
[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#d9ead3][size=4][center]Compatibility[/center]
[/size][/color][/font][size=3]✓ Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE): The updated Secret Woods map is taken into account. If additional compatibility is needed, feel free to let me know ;)
All warp points are equipped with signposts for easy navigation.

[color=#d9d2e9]House and Starter Pack[/color]
✓ Interior: If you don’t use a custom house, a cozy pre-made interior awaits you, including a bed, TV, table, dresser, and rugs (sadly, they can’t be hung on the wall — haha).
✓ Author’s gift: As a starter pack, you will receive an expanded chest for your first resources.

[color=#d9d2e9]Available Settings (Config)[/color]
Before starting the game, you can customize the farm to your liking:
✓ Starter Pack: Standard or Expanded
✓ Secret Woods warp: Standard or adapted for Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)
✓ Fence near the house: Can be placed for clear zoning or removed for a more open space

Start your Stardew Valley adventure on a farm where every detail is designed for beauty, comfort, and tranquility. “Forest Haven” is waiting for its farmer![/size]
[size=5][color=#93c47d][center]Attention![/center][/color][/size]
[size=3]This is my first mod. If you encounter any issues or bugs, please let me know — I’ll do my best to fix them.[/size]
